history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man in a formal military uniform stands with his hands in his pockets, looking directly at the camera. The uniform is a dark brown with intricate gold detailing and multiple medals and insignia adorning the chest and epaulets. A distinctive red and gold cord is draped over his left shoulder. He has short, neatly styled dark hair and a serious expression.

The background features a grand, white colonial-style building with large windows and columns, illuminated from within, suggesting it might be an official residence or academy. The sky is a deep twilight blue, with the last remnants of daylight fading. The lighting is dramatic, with the building and the subject well-lit, contrasting with the darkening sky and the surrounding darkness, creating a slightly formal and imposing mood. The overall color palette consists of deep browns, gold, white, and the dark blues and grays of the evening sky. The photograph has a professional, portrait-like quality.
